purpose: Mechanically audited Protected Mode contract for the complete direct 01F7:5937 body, excluding the runtime-selected nested callback at 01F7:0598.

contract.name: update_auxiliary_player_dispatch_5937
contract.calling_convention: far; called from 01F7:3FF8 with ES:DI object context and no stack arguments; RETF at 5BED; caller consumes neither AX nor flags
contract.outputs: No player-record output. Direct writes are DS:60DA, DS:4FF2, DS:4FF8, and DS:4FFA. DS:4FF6 is read but not written by 5937.
contract.scheduler_position: First operation in the player callback, before the DS:89EA transition gate and before movement/collision work
contract.object_effects: Calls 01F7:386F for changed dispatch bits and auxiliary score/count/lives/ammo records; any pooled object or renderer effect is selected by the nested 0442/0598 resource callback
contract.feeds_back_into_simulation: The direct body has no player or callback-global simulation write. The only unresolved feedback edge is the runtime-selected far callback reached through 0442:0598.

secondary_dispatch.score: When DS:881C != DS:4FF2, writes DS:4FF2 and dispatches AX=0x00CE/0x00D7/0x00E0/0x00E9/0x00F2/0x00FB, BX=0x0008, CX=successive quotient+0x01F4 for divisors 100000/10000/1000/100/10/1
secondary_dispatch.display_count: Compares DS:4FF8 with DS:8822; signed JL selects CX=0x0200 and decrements the published count, otherwise increments and selects CX=0x01FF; AX=0x0062+9*selected_count, BX=0x0006
secondary_dispatch.lives: Clamps negative DS:880A to zero for the comparison/write, writes DS:4FFA on change, then dispatches AX=0x00FE/BX=0x0005/CX=0x0031 and AX=0x005A/BX=0x0008/CX=min(raw_DS:880A,9)+0x01F4
secondary_dispatch.ammo: If DS:880C != DS:4FF6, dispatches AX=0x00B4 and 0x00BD, BX=0x0008, CX=quotient/remainder digits+0x01F4; 4FF6 remains a read-only comparison in this body

callees.name: publish_view_state_386F
callees.flags: AX/BX/CX forwarded; nested flags not consumed

callees.name: address_named_record_callback_call_0598
callees.flags: runtime DS:6D8A record +0x18/+0x1A far callback may have external side effects

unresolved_boundary.question: Can a runtime DS:6D8A record callback write player simulation state?
unresolved_boundary.static_conclusion: No direct 5937/386F/0442 body write reaches player state; only runtime callback code can change that conclusion.
unresolved_boundary.next: Retain the runtime target address-named and attribute any held-out parity mismatch to it only after a complete target-inclusive trace.
